sql_attempts.notes: Initial schema inspection succeeded; only the last SELECT result was exposed. A combined metadata query then failed with SQLSTATE 42601; corrected once using CTEs. No retry with relaxed timeouts. The three retained successful evidence queries follow.

indexes.name: catalog_location_prices_lookup_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX catalog_location_prices_lookup_idx ON public.catalog_location_prices USING btree (store, location_id, product_id) WHERE published

indexes.name: catalog_location_prices_new_feed_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX catalog_location_prices_new_feed_idx ON public.catalog_location_prices USING btree (store, location_id, first_seen_at DESC, product_id) WHERE (published AND available)

indexes.name: catalog_location_prices_offer_feed_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX catalog_location_prices_offer_feed_idx ON public.catalog_location_prices USING btree (store, location_id, promo_end, product_id) WHERE (published AND available AND (promo_type IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: catalog_location_prices_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_location_prices_pkey ON public.catalog_location_prices USING btree (id)

indexes.name: catalog_location_prices_store_product_id_location_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_location_prices_store_product_id_location_id_key ON public.catalog_location_prices USING btree (store, product_id, location_id)

result.sample_method: First 200 published rows by product_id per selected store/location, not random or family-stratified
